Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring consumer reporting agencies to only use actual claims in underwriting decisions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to insurer inquiries to consumer reportingagencies; and adding a new section to chapter 19.182 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.182 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Consumer reporting agencies may not include mere inquiries toan insurer regarding the terms and conditions of an insured consumer'sreal property insurance coverage to the agency's data base. Businessdata bases used for comprehensive loss underwriting exchange purposes,and relied upon by insurers for underwriting decisions, may onlycontain information regarding actual claim history. (2) All rights of inspection and correction, and other remediesavailable under this chapter, apply to consumers of real propertyinsurance, in regard to data and reports or credit scores maintained byconsumer reporting agencies.
